english.notes:
(i) For offences relating to the abduction of children under the age of 16 years - see the offence wordings: H2065, H2066 and H2067.
(ii) The consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions is required for prosecution of attempted kidnapping a child under 16 by a person connected with the child. (Section 5 Child Abduction Act 1984).
(iii) Where this offence is committed against an emergency worker this must be treated as an aggravating factor in sentencing, see section 67 of the Sentencing Act 2020.
(iv) Terrorist connection - this offence is listed in Schedule 1 to the Sentencing Act 2020. Where the court has determined that there is a terrorist connection, the court has to treat this as an aggravating factor in sentencing (section 69 of that Act) and the notification requirements under the Counter-Terrorism Act 2008 apply (section 42 of that Act). In addition, section 23A of the Terrorism Act 2000 provides for forfeiture of money or other property.
